evidence.label: What is the hardest technical challenge you've faced as part of work experience or a personal project? (Approx. 200 words) ✱
evidence.expected: In a fictional student project, I built a small event-processing service. Duplicate events caused incorrect totals when a worker retried after a timeout. I added idempotency keys, made the update transactional, and tested retries with a fault-injection script. The difficult part was separating an acknowledged request from a committed update and choosing an invariant that both the application and tests could check. I documented the recovery behavior and the limits of the test environment.
